predecessors.name: Qing dynasty
predecessors.text: Dali and its lake basin, the base of the rebellion

successors.name: Qing dynasty
successors.text: Dali and what was left of the rebel land in western Yunnan, retaken by Qing troops; the Panthay Rebellion page dates the capture to January 1873, the Du Wenxiu page to the encirclement of 25 December…

ledger.x: 1856: the Hui of Yunnan take Dali and proclaim Du Wenxiu generalissimo.
1860: the Sultanate reaches its peak in western Yunnan.
1871: the Qing campaign to destroy the Hui of Yunnan is under way.
1872: Qing troops encircle Dali on 25 December.
1872: Du Wenxiu is beheaded at Dali and the Sultanate ends.

wars.name: Panthay Rebellion
wars.outcome: Qing victory: Dali fell in December 1872 or January 1873 (the pages differ), Du Wenxiu was beheaded; about one million dead.

certainty.note: A rebel state whose land the pages name only by its towns (Dali, Lijiang, Zhongdian, Heqing, Tengyue); no boundary is given.
